name: Ten-map temporal allocation and matching comparison for SAM2 memory ToMe
status: engineering gate required; full-cohort efficacy inference has not started
question: With the same ten selected history maps and the same native total spatial K/V budget, does preserving more spatial tokens in recent maps improve full-video segmentation, and does predicted-region-aware ToMe matching help beyond generic ToMe?

prior_evidence.source: Completed wider_history_fixed_budget_v1 full-video run and read-only seq6/seq8 trajectory audit
prior_evidence.observation: The native, generic and regional predictions match through six history maps. After compression begins, ToMe improves seq8 reappearance but increases GT-empty false alarms, while seq6 degrades. Generic and regional ToMe are nearly identical.
prior_evidence.limitation: History length, per-map spatial density and reuse of the oldest temporal slot changed together in the 12-map run. The seq6/seq8 audit was post-hoc; this candidate is exploratory on the already analyzed PolypGen cohort.

scope.evidence_class: Exploratory mechanism comparison only; this cohort has informed candidate design and cannot serve as untouched confirmation.

fixed_design.sam2: Use the same pinned SAM2.1 Hiera-T checkpoint, frame schedule, prompt, memory writes, dense current-frame queries, decoder and object pointers as the completed wider-history run.
fixed_design.history: Use the same nearest-history frame IDs, capped at ten non-conditioning maps in all four treatment arms. Never choose maps by quality, confidence, loss or predicted outcome.
fixed_design.budget: Keep one dense conditioning map at 4096 tokens and the saturated non-conditioning budget at exactly 24576 tokens; total spatial K/V budget is 28672, with pointers additional and unchanged.
fixed_design.temporal_position: Keep native age embeddings for ages 1..6 and repeat the native oldest non-conditioning age slot for ages 7..10. All arms use the same treatment. This does not encode exact age beyond six.
fixed_design.merge: Reuse the pinned upstream ToMe bipartite soft matching and mass-weighted merge. Merge within each frame's existing 4x4 windows only, after native K/V projection and RoPE; never merge across frames. Keep the same additive log-mass attention correction.
fixed_design.weights: No training. Freeze all pretrained SAM2 parameters and leave image encoder, memory writer, current queries, decoder and bank contents unchanged by the read intervention.

factorial_conditions.name: uniform_generic
factorial_conditions.allocation: For N<=6 maps, retain all tokens. For 7<=N<=10, distribute 24576 tokens evenly across the N maps; assign integer remainder tokens to the most recent maps.

factorial_conditions.name: uniform_regional
factorial_conditions.matching: Same projected-key similarity augmented by the same stored predicted soft foreground/background/boundary-role metric used in the prior wider-history study
factorial_conditions.allocation: Identical per-map and per-window token quotas to uniform_generic.

factorial_conditions.name: recent_dense_generic
factorial_conditions.allocation: For N<=6 maps, retain all tokens. For 7<=N<=10, assign 2048 tokens to each of the oldest N-6 maps; distribute the remaining budget (24576 - 2048*(N-6)) evenly across the six most recent maps, giving remainder tokens to the newest maps.

factorial_conditions.name: recent_dense_regional
factorial_conditions.allocation: Identical per-map and per-window token quotas to recent_dense_generic.

planned_interpretation.allocation_effect: Compare recent_dense_generic with uniform_generic while holding the ten-map frame set, merge operator, total budget and SAM2 behavior fixed.
planned_interpretation.region_effect: Compare regional with generic matching within each allocation while holding every frame/window quota fixed.
planned_interpretation.interaction: Check whether the region-matching effect changes under recency-weighted versus uniform spatial density. Treat this as exploratory, not a confirmatory significance claim.
planned_interpretation.multiple_testing: Paired sequence-level Wilcoxon tests and sequence-bootstrap 95% intervals; Holm correction across these five fixed contrasts. Report every contrast, including negative results.
planned_interpretation.historical_context: The archived native six-map and generic/regional twelve-map results are contextual references, not matched primary contrasts for this ten-map study.

checks: Exact fresh-process native replay through reads with at most six history maps.
For every treatment, verify selected source-frame IDs match across four arms at each target and age positions are identical.
Verify every per-frame and 4x4-window quota, exact 28672 spatial-token saturation when N>6, and mass conservation including unchanged pointers.
Verify ToMe source hashes, finite attention outputs, unchanged SAM2 parameters, unchanged memory writes, restoration of temporal-slot state and independent-process replay.
Verify uniform and recent-dense quota rules with unit cases for every N from 1 through 10, including the 2048-token local merge limit.

primary_metrics: Equal-sequence mean present-frame Dice over complete post-prompt videos
evaluation.analysis: Report all four arms and fixed archived references. Since this candidate was chosen after inspecting the same cohort, present paired intervals and tests descriptively; do not call them confirmatory or use the cohort to tune a follow-up variant.
evaluation.stop_rule: Do not proceed to another PolypGen variant after this comparison. Regardless of outcome, require untouched-data evaluation before claiming a reliable or generalizable method.

not_included.aggregation: Do not add channel-wise max pooling; only mass-weighted ToMe aggregation is used, so the temporal allocation and regional matching effects remain interpretable.
not_included.matching: Do not relaunch ATC or PiToMe; their frozen continuation screens failed.
not_included.region_identification: Do not add Grad-CAM, TokenCut, k-means or pointer-centred grouping to this experiment. Existing probes do not provide a reliable segmentation benefit and would create additional factors.
not_included.other: No thresholds, confidence gates, frame-quality selection, cross-frame merging, learned parameters or test-set-based tuning.
